scripts.ready: ./node_modules/.bin/vp fmt && ./node_modules/.bin/vp lint && vp run server#build && vp run website#build && vp run @cc-heart/open-chat#build
scripts.build:package: vp run website#build && vp run @cc-heart/open-chat#build && node tools/open-chat/scripts/stage-package.mjs
scripts.kill: lsof -ti :3000 -sTCP:LISTEN | xargs kill -9 2>/dev/null; lsof -ti :8082 -sTCP:LISTEN | xargs kill -9 2>/dev/null; lsof -ti :4311 -sTCP:LISTEN | xargs kill -9 2>/dev/null; echo "ports 3000/8082/4311 cleaned"
scripts.kill:all: lsof -ti :3000 -sTCP:LISTEN | xargs kill -9 2>/dev/null; lsof -ti :8082 -sTCP:LISTEN | xargs kill -9 2>/dev/null; lsof -ti :5173 -sTCP:LISTEN | xargs kill -9 2>/dev/null; lsof -ti :4311 -sTCP:LISTEN | xargs kill -9 2>/dev/null; echo "all dev ports cleaned"
